data.name: OCT data & Color Fundus Images of Left & Right Eyes
data.abstract: This dataset contains OCT data (in mat format) and color fundus data (in jpg format) of left & right eyes of 50 healthy persons.

additional_info.summary: OCT data & Color Fundus Images of Left & Right Eyes : This dataset contains OCT data (in mat format) and color fundus data (in jpg format) of left & right eyes of 50 healthy persons. Each volunteer's folder includes color fundus images (.jpg) and OCT data (.mat) of the right and left eyes.
